zones: the selected card's authorized cast zone
objects: one source-pinned ordinary Improvise spell or reviewed typed next-spell grant
phased-in untapped artifacts currently controlled by the caster
state_writes: tap each selected artifact through the canonical casting tap-cost transaction
costs: each selected artifact pays exactly one generic mana
Improvise cannot pay colored or colorless requirements
one selected artifact cannot also activate for mana during the same payment
Improvise applies after the represented total cost is determined
timing: artifact selection occurs after activating mana abilities and while paying the spell's total cost
choices: the caster selects zero or more distinct currently eligible artifacts
hidden_information: the hand spell remains owner-private until cast
the executable selection is exposed only to its caster
layers: artifact status comes from the canonical current effective-characteristic query
printed Improvise addition or removal is excluded until the shared ability-applicability query exists
copy: a copied spell was not cast and does not use Improvise
control_change: only artifacts currently controlled by the caster are eligible at offer and commitment
zone_change: changing zone or logical incarnation invalidates a selected artifact before mutation
source_leaves: the spell and every selected artifact are revalidated before payment commitment

variants: one reviewed typed next-spell Improvise grant

implementation.supported_slice: Ordinary printed Improvise on a trusted selected cast face or one reviewed typed next-spell grant, paying only generic mana with current controlled artifacts.

known_blockers: arbitrary granted, copied, removed, or text-changed Improvise until one shared ability-applicability query exists
unrepresented cost-payment replacements and complete total-cost interaction grammar
